app_fee.value: Central NUS Graduate School (nusgs.nus.edu.sg) and Faculty of Science pages are blocked by Imperva/Incapsula WAF; individual schools/departments state fees (e.g., S$50 in School of Computing).

fee_waiver.value: Accessible NUS doctoral admissions pages do not state an international application fee waiver policy (nusgs.nus.edu.sg blocked by Imperva/Incapsula).

gre_general.value: GRE requirements are set by each faculty and department (optional in School of Computing and Statistics; strongly encouraged in Chemistry and Mathematics).

toefl_min.value: University-wide baseline minimum for NUS is TOEFL iBT 85 (several faculties set higher requirements, such as 90 in Computing and 95 / 5 on the new scale in Chemistry).
toefl_min.quote: the minimum TOEFL score ranges for NUS: | Internet-Based (iBT): 85

ielts_min.value: University-wide baseline minimum for NUS is IELTS 6.0 (some departments set higher requirements, such as 7.0 in Chemistry).
ielts_min.quote: the minimum TOEFL score ranges for NUS: | For IELTS, the score should be 6 and above.

english_waiver.value: Applicants whose medium of undergraduate instruction was English may be exempt from TOEFL/IELTS depending on faculty verification; otherwise an approved test score is required.
english_waiver.quote: * The following guidelines are provided for applicants whose native language or medium of undergraduate instruction is not English

also.quote: *International applicants who graduated from universities where English is not the main medium of communication must submit TOEFL (http://www.ets.org/) or IELTS (International English Language Testing System) (http://www.ielts.org) scores.

a candidate whose medium of undergraduate instruction is not English is required to submit TOEFL (with the minimum score 95 (old scale) or 5 (new scale) for the internet-based test) or IELTS (with the minimum score 7.0) scores.

notes: Five Faculty of Science / School of Computing PhD programmes verified from accessible official NUS department pages (cs, chemistry, statistics [+datasci], math, biology). Imperva/Incapsula WAF blocked automated fetching of nusgs.nus.edu.sg, science.nus.edu.sg, cde.nus.edu.sg (engineering PhDs: bme, chemeng, civil, ece, materials, mech), medicine.nus.edu.sg (biomed, neuro), fass.nus.edu.sg/geog/ (earth, environment), and collapsed accordions on physics.nus.edu.sg.
